data.description: The Hot Air Balloon is a flying vehicle with 18 slots of storage on board. Buy one from the [Airwolf Vendor](/world/airwolf-vendor) for 150 [scrap](/items/scrap) and it comes with 75 low grade already in the tank. It burns 12 low grade a minute, so a full 500 tank gets you about 42 minutes in the air. To repair it, hit it with a hammer for up to 100 cloth. Left outside it decays in 3 hours, while inside it doesn't decay.
